# Synthetic WOIAF fixtures

**These pages are hand-written test fixtures, not copies of A Wiki of Ice and Fire.**
They imitate WOIAF's MediaWiki markup (a `{{Character}}` infobox, `==History==`,
`==Recent Events==` with per-book subsections, `==Quotes by …==`, `<ref>`s) so that
the parser, the time-slicer and the cast selector can be tested offline. Facts are
abbreviated and approximate. The real wiki is validated live with
`nemothrones lore probe` and `nemothrones doctor`.
